title: SDKenV field handoff - 20min playbook
content:
Purpose: a compact, pragmatic runbook to hand an SDK environment (sdkenv) to a customer or internal integrator in ~20 minutes. Focus is: reproducible smoke checks, quick telemetry sanity, minimal sample app, and resilient fallback paths.

Audience: solutions engineers, developer advocates, and oncall engineers doing field demos or light pilot handoffs.

Scope: not a full docs site — this is a field checklist + runnable snippets + quick debugging heuristics. Use alongside the main quickstart and the SDK repo README.

Estimated timeline (20m):
- 0-3m: verify pre-reqs & access (API key, region, network).
- 3-6m: launch sample app (one command).
- 6-10m: run core smoke tests (generation + embed).
- 10-14m: check telemetry & cost signals.
- 14-18m: exercise failure/fallback flows (simulate quota, latency).
- 18-20m: capture logs, note follow-ups, handover.

Pre-reqs (quick verify):
- Account with API key (ENV var REDWOOD_API_KEY).
- Network egress allowed to api.redwood.ai (or private endpoint).
- Node 18+ or Python 3.10+ locally for sample app.
- If private/dedicated: kube/ops contact and region tag.

Quick launch (one-line):
- Node (recommended demo):
  npx @redwood/sdk-playground --api-key $REDWOOD_API_KEY --model redwood-v1-mini
- Or python:
  python -m sdkenv.sample_app --key $REDWOOD_API_KEY --model redwood-v1-mini
Notes: npx binary uses cached build, fastest for demos.

Minimal smoke tests (run after launch):
1) Text generation sanity
- curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-mini","prompt":"Translate to French: \'Hello world\'","max_tokens":20}'
- Expected: short French output, <500ms to 2s for hosted demo. Flag if >4s.

2) Embedding pipeline
- curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":"hello"}'
- Expected: 1536-d vector (or documented size), non-empty numeric array.

3) Streaming test (if using UI)
- Start playground, type a long prompt; ensure tokens stream progressively. Failure mode: full-blocked response = streaming disabled or proxy problem.

Telemetry quick checks (where to look):
- Console / dashboard: per-request latency percentiles (P50/P95), token count, error rate.
- Guardrails: generation failures >1% in demo = investigate model mismatch or rate limit.
- Cost spike: watch token-per-request compared to sample prompts.

Canonical failure scenarios to exercise (fast):
- API key invalid: expect 401 with message 'invalid_api_key'.
- Model not found: 404 and model fallback should trigger (if rollout policy set).
- Rate limit: 429 and SDK should surface Retry-After header. Confirm client retry logic behaves as expected.
- High latency: simulate by blocking network for 1s — verify UI shows loading spinner and can cancel.

Fallback playbook (quick):
- If 401: check key env var, paste key into playground, confirm scopes.
- If 429: reduce concurrency to 1-2, enable cached prefix, or switch to a lower-tier model.
- If model mismatch: change model param to documented stable tag (e.g., redwood-v1-stable).

Observability capture (what to save for handoff):
- Console screenshots: request table filtered to last 10 requests.
- A sample curl for a failing request.
- SDK logs (attach last 200 lines from local run).
- Trace id(s) from dashboard for slow requests.

Handoff notes template (copyable):
- Customer / integrator: [name]
- API key used: [redacted partial: sk-***abcd]
- Region: [us-west1 / eu-central1]
- Sample app link: [repo/commit]
- Smoke tests passed: [list]
- Known issues & next steps: [bullet list]

Rapid debugging checklist (order matters):
1) Confirm API key + network (curl to /health).
2) Check model param and compatibility list.
3) Look at HTTP status, headers (Retry-After, X-Request-Id).
4) Check SDK client version (npx vs pinned).
5) Re-run minimal curl with verbose flags to capture timings.

Small snippets (copy-paste)
- Curl health: curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/health -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"
- Quick Node generate (js):
  import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
  const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
  await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1-mini', prompt: 'Summarize: ...' });

Unresolved questions (for follow-up):
- Should demo default to a quantized smaller model to keep latency consistent across regions? (ops input needed)
- Do we want an explicit 'demo' key with rate limits for SEs? (biz/legal)
- Add a pre-built troubleshooting script that collects logs + trace ids automatically? (priority: medium)

Quick todos (next 1–2 sprints):
- 1) Bake a one-click sandbox link that sets environment and opens playground (owner: Ethan).
- 2) Add capture script to SDK repo that prints short diagnostic bundle (owner: Maya).
- 3) Document recommended prompt set for demos with expected token counts (owner: Priya).

Notes to self: keep this doc intentionally short — field engineers need a checklist, not a novel. Capture more complex recovery flows in a separate long-form runbook.

References: attach main quickstart, SDK README, and the dashboard alerting page.

End of playbook.
